results.description:
Simply Auto, trusted by thousands of users worldwide, is a vehicle management app for cars, motorcycles, trucks and fleets. It helps with fuel management, maintenance reminders, mileage recording and tracking other vehicle expenses. The app provides secure backups on the cloud too.

Track Your Fuel log and Vehicle Expenses
• This app helps you to track your vehicle maintenance, fill-ups, mileage, expenses, and trips.
• Capture and upload receipts at the time of fill-ups or later
• Send reports for fill-ups and mileage logs directly from the app
• Various stats and graphs available for you to track fuel efficiency, fuel cost/month, service cost/kilometre, monthly tax-deduction, etc.
• The only fuel log that lets you track your car's fuel economy by Octane, Fuel Brand and Filling Station
• Electric car owners can track their vehicle in Kilowatt-Hour.

Manage Your Vehicle Maintenance
• Set service reminders by mileage or date
• Add multiple receipts for fill-ups, services, and expenses
• Manage all your vehicle expenses and maintenance reminders for small and medium fleets
• Track your vehicle’s fuel running cost

Track Your Trips and Tax-Deduction
• GPS tracker record all your tax deductible and reimbursable mileage
• Maintains business as well as a personal trip log

Instant Back-Up on Cloud
• 100% Instant backup on the cloud
• Sync across multiple devices

Share Data with Multiple Drivers
• Share data instantly with multiple drivers sharing vehicles.

Other Key Features:
• Access your vehicle database on the web at our website
• Schedule Automated week/monthly reports
• Multiple vehicles supported
• A perfect companion for Uber, Lyft and other rideshares drivers
• Export and import log files as CSV to phone memory or Google Drive
• Supports voice input. So, you can speak and enter values for fill-ups
• Import data directly from aCar. For any other app, we have a self-explanatory guide within the app, or you could write to us at support@simplyauto.app
• Multiple settings available to track your data (kilometer, mile, litre, gallon (US), gallon (UK), km/l, l/100kms, mpg (US), mpg (UK))
• Supports partial fill-ups
• Highly customizable screens
• Change the quantity unit for individual fill-ups


Simply Auto offers two types of In-App Purchases
1) GOLD, which is a one time purchase and includes:
• Instantly backup all your data in the cloud
• Sync between multiple devices using the same login
• Get access to your data on the web (our website)
• Track trips via GPS
• Backup and restore receipts on Google Drive
• Add new service and expense types
• Email your receipts and logs
• Remove Ads

2) PLATINUM, which is a yearly subscription and includes:
• All features of GOLD
• Add unlimited vehicles
• Sync data with unlimited drivers
• Send automated weekly or monthly reports
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase

"T & C: http://www.simplyauto.app/Terms2.html"
"Privacy Policy: http://simplyauto.app/policy.html"

Vehicle Maintenance Tracker (VMT) is a simple yet powerful tool designed to help you keep a complete history of your vehicles’ maintenance. Whether you're tracking a single car or managing a fleet, VMT makes it easy to stay organized and informed.

Key Features:
*Add and update vehicle details, including photo, VIN, license plate, year, make, model, tire size, oil filter type, current odometer, and annual maintenance costs.
*Set, view, and reset due dates for upcoming services.
*Archive vehicles you no longer own and restore or permanently delete them at any time.
*Manage maintenance records for multiple vehicles—oil changes, brakes, tires, batteries, and more.
*Attach photos of maintenance receipts for better documentation.
*Search and filter maintenance records easily.
*Maintenance entries are organized and sorted chronologically for quick reference.
*Export or email vehicle data in CSV format for printing or sharing.

I hope you enjoy using VMT as much as I enjoyed building it. If you have any questions, feedback, or suggestions, feel free to reach out—and don't forget to join the **VMT community on Facebook**! It's the best way to connect with me and other users, get updates, and suggest new features.

Happy Tracking!

Easily track your vehicle’s fuel economy and vehicle maintenance records.  Set up reminders to keep on top of maintenance tasks such as oil changes and tire rotations.  Fuelly makes it easy for you to save money with gas mileage calculations (MPG) and service reminders.

The Fuelly app seamlessly integrates with Fuelly.com, the web’s most used gas mileage tracking website.  Easily manage the cars in your garage and log each fuel-up.  At each fuel-up, just add the miles, gallons and price per gallon and see your MPG data grow.  All data is beautifully displayed and perfectly synchronized with your vehicle on Fuelly.com

Take complete control of your vehicle finances with My Car! The all-in-one solution for tracking fuel consumption, maintenance costs, and overall vehicle performance with incredible ease.

SAVE MONEY AND TIME WITH MY CAR:
• Instantly track and analyze fuel efficiency to reduce consumption costs
• Maintain detailed records of all vehicle expenses in one secure place
• Never miss important maintenance with comprehensive service history
• Make smarter decisions with visual statistics and detailed charts

FREE FEATURES:
• Powerful fuel mileage tracker supporting all fuel types (gas, diesel, electric, hybrid)
• Complete expense tracking for services, repairs, and all vehicle-related costs
• Built-in photo gallery to document your vehicles and maintenance
• Digital receipt storage - attach photos and documents to any recorded event
• Location memory for fuel stations and service centers for easier data entry
• Comprehensive event history with advanced search and filtering options
• Insightful statistics and charts: fuel efficiency trends, price fluctuations, cost breakdowns, monthly expenses, and much more
• Support for multiple vehicles (manage up to 3 vehicles with the free version)

• Easy data import from Fuelio, Fuelly, Drivvo and other similar apps
• Secure data export and backup options
• Modern, intuitive interface designed for simplicity and efficiency

PREMIUM FEATURES:
• Secure cloud storage with automatic synchronization across all your devices
• Access your vehicle data anytime from mobile or desktop via our web app
• Generate professional PDF reports for expenses, maintenance, and efficiency
• Expanded vehicle management (up to 6 vehicles or 100 with Premium Business)
• Multi-driver support with customizable access permissions
• Income tracking for business uses (rentals, ride-sharing, deliveries)
• Customizable service reminders to stay on top of maintenance schedules
• Trip log
• Ad-free experience for uninterrupted usage
• Additional premium features regularly added

Perfect for individual car owners, motorcycle enthusiasts, and small business fleet managers who want complete visibility and control over their vehicle expenses.

Download My Car today and start making smarter decisions about your vehicle expenses!
